name: @pcmid/dsh-async-agents
description: Keeps an agent from blocking on background work: long shell commands move to background jobs, and the agent ends its turn instead of waiting for jobs or subagents. Covers the main agent of a session; on a DSH that keeps subagents loaded, also subagents that report to their parent, with a close_agent tool to unload idle ones.
author: pcmid
